units.title: iter1: NN-GRAPH retrain pipeline NUL byte fix — unblocked retrain end-to-end
units.details: Single NUL byte at offset 6869 (line 152 buildTrainAdjacency separator) made pipeline non-importable as ESM. Fixed: byte 0x00 → 0x20. Matches canonical git HEAD verbatim. Preserves 19 other lines of post-HEAD changes. Verified: node --check PASS, dynamic import 13 exports load. Unblocks nn-graph-retrain-lifecycle.mjs end-to-end.

units.title: iter2: ShopProfileAdapterEngine — per-shop EWMA calibration learning
units.details: Per-shop calibration layer ABOVE ShopConfigurationEngine + BELOW cost/quote/time engines. EWMA fold (alpha=0.15), confidence-from-ess asymptotic shape, multiplier clamp [0.33, 3.0], S(x)<0.70 anomaly route, min 3 evidence_count floor. JM Die baseline $55/hr labor canonical per CLAUDE.md TEST SHOP. Pure engine; caller supplies storage.

units.title: iter3: PSNSelfImprovingLoopEngine — composes CoV + ShopAdapter + PSNAutonomy
units.details: The loop closer. One async ingest() call = one closed-loop iteration. Verify→fold→score. R12 fail-loud: hallucinated/conflict verdicts do NOT corrupt the per-shop delta. classifyVerdict pure helper exposed. Cross-PSN integration via psi_delta signal to PSNAutonomyLoopEngine.scoreEvent.

units.title: iter4: 160x embedding hit rate + AUROC 0.5 → 0.6129
units.details: Root cause of pre-existing 23/5977 (0.4%) embedding hit rate: buildAdjacency caps via slice(0,N) on raw node order; embedder covered 3700 nodes, 6000-cap sampled from 288K total → intersection 23. Fix: prioritizeEmbeddedNodes() reorders nodes so embedded ones come first before slice. loadEmbeddingNodeIds() cheap n-only pre-scan. RESULT: hit 3681/2317 (61.4%), AUROC 0.5 → 0.6129 (above random for first time in MS2).

units.title: iter5: prism_shop LOOP_ACTIONS — MCP-invokable
units.details: Three new actions on prism_shop dispatcher: loop_shop_summary (sanitized totals + confidence, no raw identifiers), loop_shop_deltas (frozen ShopAdapterDeltas snapshot), loop_shop_reset (clear deltas for one shop with explicit shop_id required). shop_id defaults to jm-die per CLAUDE.md TEST SHOP. ALL_ACTIONS grew by 3 (anti-regression preserved).

units.title: iter6: ShopOutcomeIngestProcessorEngine — operational closure (JSONL → ingest automation)
units.details: Reads any JSONL outcome stream, iterates rows, builds LoopIngestInput per row, calls PSNSelfImprovingLoopEngine.ingest, emits LoopIngestResult to sink. Pure when injectable; defaults wire fs + singletons. defaultBoundsCheckVerifierFactory (substrate-free, ratio in [0.5, 2.0]). BUGFIX in PSNSelfImprovingLoopEngine: adapter-folded detection used category-count growth (only fires on first outcome per category) — fixed to use anomaly-count growth. All 19 existing PSN tests + 19 new processor tests pass.
